issues.diagnosis: The synthesis collapses distinct local situations into a single undifferentiated theme, ignoring the varied support and challenges described in the excerpts.
issues.requested_change: Acknowledge the diverse local contexts and speaker perspectives presented in the excerpts.

rating.rationale: The excerpts present distinct descriptions of support (money, transport, social) and challenges (pregnancy, changing demands). The claim that there are no meaningful contextual differences is an oversimplification. Revision is needed to acknowledge the varied local contexts and speaker perspectives.
